managewiki-setting-wgAbuseFilterActions-: Ficillada suurtagalka ah ee ay qaadi karaan shaandhooyinka xadgudubka. Marka aad ku darto ficil cusub, hubi inuu ku xaddidan yahay $wgAbuseFilterRestrictions, haddii uu ku xaddidanna, ha illoobin inaad ku darto rukhsadda abusefilter-modify-restricted kooxaha isticmaalayaasha ku habboon.
managewiki-setting-wgAutoBlockExpiry-nam: Wakhtiga uu dhacayo xannibaadda tooska ah
managewiki-setting-wgAutoBlockExpiry-hel: Tirada ilbiriqsiyada ka hor inta aanay dhammaan gelinnada xannibaadda tooska ah. Qiimaha ugu yar ee la oggol yahay waa 0, halka qiimaha ugu sarreeya uu yahay 10 sano (315360000).
managewiki-setting-wgBlockAllowsUTEdit-n: Waxay u oggolaanaysaa isticmaalayaasha xannibaya inay xaddidaan gelitaanka bogga wadahadalka
managewiki-setting-wgBlockAllowsUTEdit-h: Waxay u oggolaanaysaa isticmaalaha xannibaya inuu siiyo isticmaalaha la xannibay oggolaanshaha waxb ka beddelka bogga wadahadalka.
managewiki-setting-wgCookieSetOnAutobloc: Kukiga lagu dejiyey xannibaadda tooska ah

Waxay go'aamisaa in kuki la dejiyo marka isticmaalaha si toos ah loo xannibo. Haddii sidaas la sameeyo, isticmaalaha la xannibay, xitaa ka dib marka uu ka baxo akoonkiisa oo uu u wareego cinwaan IP cusub, weli waa la xannibi doonaa.
managewiki-setting-wgCookieSetOnIpBlock-: Kukiga lagu dejiyo xannibaadda cinwaanka IP-ga

Waxay go'aamisaa in kuki la dejiyo marka isticmaalaha cinwaanka IP-ga la xannibo. Haddii sidaas la sameeyo, isticmaalaha la xannibay, xitaa ka dib marka uu u wareego cinwaan IP cusub, weli waa la xannibi doonaa.
managewiki-setting-wgEmailConfirmToEdit-: Xaqiijinta iimaylka si wax looga beddelo

Waxaa loo baahan yahay isticmaalayaasha inay xaqiijiyaan cinwaankooda iimaylka ka hor inta aanay wax ka beddeli karin. Tani waxay si wax-ku-ool ah u joojinaysaa wax-ka-beddelka ay sameeyaan cinwaannada IP-ga.
managewiki-setting-wgProtectSiteLimit-he: Waqtiga ugu badan ee loo oggol yahay ilaalinta goobta.
managewiki-setting-wgProtectSiteDefaultT: Waqtiga caadiga ah ee ilaalinta goobta
Waqtiga caadiga ah ee dhicitaanka, 1 saac ayaa ah qiimaha caadiga ah.
managewiki-setting-wmgFlaggedRevsProtect: Ilaalinta dib u eegista la calaamadeeyey
Tani waxay awood u siinaysaa ilaalinta dib u eegista la calaamadeeyey.
managewiki-setting-wmgFlaggedRevsAutoRev: Dib u eegista tooska ah ee dib u eegisyada la calaamadeeyey
managewiki-setting-wmgSimpleFlaggedRevsU: Is dhexgalka fudud ee dib u eegisyada la calaamadeeyey
Marka la hawlgeliyo, tani waxay kala saari doontaa oo keliya "la hubiyey", "tayo leh", iyo "aan dib loo eegin".
managewiki-setting-wmgFlaggedRevsLowProf: Muuqaalka hoose ee dib u eegisyada la calaamadeeyey
Marka la hawlgeliyo, booqdayaasha tus oo keliya summadaha/astaamaha bogagga aan dib loo eegin ama waqtigoodu dhacay.
managewiki-setting-wgEchoUseCrossWikiBet: Hawl geli astaanta tijaabada ah ee Echo ee ka gudubta wiki-yada
Calanka astaanta ee astaanta tijaabada ah ee ogeysiisyada ka gudba wiki-yada.
managewiki-setting-wgMediaViewerIsInBeta: Hawl geli habka tijaabada ah ee Daawadayaasha Warbaahinta
Tani waxay Daawadayaasha Warbaahinta ka dhigaysaa astaam tijaabo ah, sidaas darteed looma hawlgelin doono dhammaan isticmaalayaasha.
managewiki-setting-wgPopupsBetaFeature-n: Hawl geli habka tijaabada ah ee soo-baxayaasha
managewiki-setting-wgPopupsBetaFeature-h: Tani waxay soo-baxayaasha ka dhigaysaa astaam tijaabo ah, halkii laga tusi lahaa dhammaan isticmaalayaasha.
managewiki-setting-wgVisualEditorEnableW: Hawl geli astaanta tijaabada ah ee Wikitext-ka Tifaftiraha Muuqaalka

Hawl geli habka cusub ee Wikitext-ka gudaha Tifaftiraha Muuqaalka oo ah astaam tijaabo ah. Waxa uu leeyahay qaar badan oo ka mid ah qalabka ku jira Tifaftiraha Muuqaalka, waxa uu adeegsadaa naqshad la mid ah, wuxuuna fududeeyaa u kala beddelashada labada hab.
managewiki-setting-wgVisualEditorShowBet: Awoodsiinta Muujinta Soo-dhaweynta Beta ee VisualEditor
Waxay muujisaa soo dhaweyn beta ah oo loogu talagalay isticmaalayaasha Tifaftiraha Muuqaalka.
managewiki-setting-wgChatLinkUsernames-h: Ku xidh bogagga isticmaalayaasha daaqadda weyn ee sheekaysiga.
managewiki-setting-wgChatMeCommand-help: Hawl geli amarka /me ''qoraal'' oo daabaca farriin nooca xaaladda ah.
managewiki-setting-wmgWebChatServer-help: Server-ka IRC ee lagu xidhmayo, looma baahna marka la isticmaalayo macmiilka webka ee LiberaChat.
managewiki-setting-wmgWebChatClient-help: Tani waxay dejinaysaa macmiilka webka la isticmaalayo. Haddii aadan isticmaalayn Libera.Chat, dooro Server kale.
managewiki-setting-wmgWikiLicense-help: Wiki kasta oo ku yaal Miraheze asal ahaan waxaa lagu shatiyeeyaa CC-BY-SA 4.0, inkastoo tan loo beddeli karo shati kale oo la taageero. Haddii aad jeclaan lahayd inaad wax-ku-biirinnada wiki-gaaga ku sii dayso shati kale, fadlan nala soo socodsii si aan kaaga dhigno mid la heli karo. Ogow in beddelidda shatiga wiki-gaaga ay saameyn ku yeelan karto bulshadaada, mana habboona in si fudud loo sameeyo.
managewiki-setting-wgRCMaxAge-help: Waxyaabaha ku jira jadwalka recentchanges si joogto ah ayaa loo tirtiraa; gelinnada ka da' weyn tiradan ilbiriqsi ayaa la tirtiri doonaa.
managewiki-setting-wgActiveUserDays-help: Tirada maalmaha uu qofku ku dhex sameeyo wax-ka-beddello si loogu tixgeliyo isticmaale "firfircoon".
managewiki-setting-wgRCLinkDays-name: Maalmaha Isbeddellada Dhawaanahan iyo Isbeddellada Dhawaanahan ee Ku Xiran
managewiki-setting-wgRCLinkDays-help: Ikhtiyaarrada tirada maalmaha lagu soo bandhigayo bogagga Special:Recentchanges iyo Special:Recentchangeslinked.
managewiki-setting-wgCommentsInRecentCha: Waxay faallooyinka ku muujisaa bogga gaarka ah ee Isbeddellada Dhawaanahan.
managewiki-setting-wgCommentsSortDescend: Faallooyinka u kala saar sida hoos u dhacaysa
Tani waxay faallooyinka u kala saartaa taariikhda hoos u dhacaysa, iyadoo sanduuqa faallada cusub iyo faallooyinka ugu dambeeyay ay ugu sarreeyaan marka la awoodsiiyo.
managewiki-setting-wgEnableScaryTransclu: U oggolow tusmada in laga soo dejiyo/lagu daro wiki kale.
managewiki-setting-wmgVisualEditorEnable: Ka dhig VisualEditor tifaftiraha caadiga ah ee dhammaan isticmaalayaasha
Tani waxay VisualEditor ka dhigi doontaa tifaftiraha caadiga ah ee dhammaan isticmaalayaasha.
managewiki-setting-wgVisualEditorEnableW: Ikhtiyaarkani wuxuu kuu oggolaanayaa inaad ku tafatirto hab-raaca Wikitext gudaha VisualEditor.
managewiki-setting-wgVisualEditorUseSing: VisualEditor ha isticmaalo hal tab tafatirid

Waxay muujisaa oo keliya tab-ka "tafatiir". Waxay si caadi ah u isticmaashaa VisualEditor haddii "Ka dhig VisualEditor tifaftiraha caadiga ah ee dhammaan isticmaalayaasha" la dejiyay, haddii kale si caadi ah ayay u isticmaashaa Wikitext.
managewiki-setting-wgAllowSlowParserFunc: Oggolow hawlaha baaraha ee gaabiska ah
Hawlaha baaraha waa "erayo sixir ah" oo soo celiya qiime sida waqtiga, faahfaahinta goobta, ama magacyada bogagga.
managewiki-setting-wgPFEnableStringFunct: Ikhtiyaarkani wuxuu ku darayaa taageerada dhowr hawlood oo aasaasi ah oo lagu maareeyo xarfaha. Tusaale ahaan: hawsha #pos waxay soo celisaa booska ereyga raadinta ee la bixiyay ee ku dhex jira xarfaha. Wax badan waxaad ka baran kartaa bogga dukumeentiyada MediaWiki https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Module:String.
managewiki-setting-wmgAllowEntityImport-: Oggolow in hay'adaha lagu soo dejiyo Special:Import iyo importDump.php.
managewiki-setting-wmgEnableEntitySearch: Si loo go'aamiyo in is-dhexgalka raadinta hay'adaha la awoodsiinayo iyo in kale.
managewiki-setting-wgRestrictDisplayTitl: Ku xaddid {{DISPLAYTITLE}} cinwaannada caadiyeeya isla furaha xog-ururinta ee kan rasmiga ah. Wiki-yada ay ku rakiban tahay kordhinta NoTitle qaab-dhismeedkan lama dejiyo.
managewiki-setting-wgCapitalLinks-help: Ka saar dejintan si looga fogaado in xarafka ugu horreeya ee xiriirrada si khasab ah looga dhigo xaraf weyn.
managewiki-setting-wgEnableCanonicalServ: Soo saar summad <link rel="canonical"> bog kasta oo tilmaamaysa adeegaha rasmiga ah ee la isticmaali karo, tusaale ahaan $wgServer ama $wgCanonicalServer.
managewiki-setting-wgPageCreationLog-hel: In la hayo diiwaanka abuurista bogagga cusub, kaas oo laga arki karo Special:Log/create.
managewiki-setting-wgMSCS_WarnNoCategori: Digniinta MsCatSelect ee qaybaha aan jirin
Sida caadiga ah, haddii aad isku daydo inaad kaydiso bog aan loo qoondeyn wax qayb ah, MsCatSelect waxay ku weydiin doontaa xaqiijin. Haddii aad rabto inaad ka fogaato tan, ka saar dejintan.
managewiki-setting-wgCodeEditorEnableCor: Si loo joojiyo tifaftiraha bogagga JavaScript iyo CSS ee magacyada xudunta ah ee MediaWiki, User iyo kuwa kale, ka saar dejintan.
managewiki-setting-wgScribuntoUseCodeEdi: Deji tan si loogu isticmaalo marka la tafatirayo bogagga Module.
managewiki-setting-wgMetaNamespace-help: Magaca loo isticmaalo magaca mashruuca. Ogow in magacan goobtu ay tahay inuu ka jiro ManageWiki/namespaces.
managewiki-setting-wgMetaNamespaceTalk-h: Magaca loo isticmaalo meel magaca wada hadalka mashruuca. Ogow in meel magacu uu ka jiro ManageWiki/namespaces.
managewiki-setting-wgUserBoard-help: Waxay bogagga astaanta bulshada ku muujisaa waxyaabaha la xiriira Sabuuradda Isticmaalaha.
managewiki-setting-wgUserProfileDisplay-: Waxay awoodsiisaa waxyaabaha caadiga ah in si caadi ah loogu muujiyo bogagga astaanta bulshada.
managewiki-setting-wgWikiForumLogsInRC-n: Ku muuji diiwaannada WikiForum ee Isbeddellada Dhawaanahan
managewiki-setting-wgWikiForumLogsInRC-h: Waxay beddeshaa muujinta diiwaannada WikiForum ee Special:RecentChanges.
managewiki-setting-wgWikiForumAllowAnony: U oggolow WikiForum aan la aqoon
U oggolow isticmaalayaasha aan la aqoon (isticmaalayaasha aan galin) inay isticmaalaan WikiForum.
managewiki-setting-wgRCWatchCategoryMemb: Ula dhaqan Ka mid noqoshada Qaybta sidii Isbeddel Dhawaanahan
Waxay isbeddellada ku yimaadda ka mid noqoshada qaybta u muujisaa ficil ahaan Special:RecentChanges.
managewiki-setting-egApprovedRevsAutomat: Si otomaatig ah u ansixi dib u eegista cusub
Ka saar calaamadda sanduuqan si dib-u-eegista cusub loogu baahdo in gacanta lagu ansixiyo xitaa haddii uu sameeyay maamule.
managewiki-setting-wgExternalLinkTarget-: Deji bartilmaameed caadi ah oo loogu talagalay xiriirinnada dibadda.
managewiki-setting-wgRottenLinksCurlTime: Tirada ilbiriqsiyada ka hor inta codsiga RottenLinks uu soo celin waayo jawaab. Ugu yaraan: 10. Ugu badnaan: 120.
managewiki-setting-wgLocaltimezone-help: Tani waxay waqtiga wiki-gaaga u waafajin doontaa aagga waqtiga ee aad doorato dhammaan isticmaalayaasha, hase yeeshee waxaa lagu beddeli karaa dookhyada isticmaalaha.
managewiki-setting-wgULSAnonCanChangeLan: U oggolow isticmaalayaasha aan la aqoon inay beddelaan luqadda
Awoodsiintu waxay u oggolaanaysaa isticmaalayaasha aan la aqoon inay xakameeyaan luqadda ay wiki-ga ku daawanayaan.
managewiki-setting-wgPageLanguageUseDB-h: Waxay oggolaanaysaa in luqadda bogagga MediaWiki la beddelo.
managewiki-setting-wgKartographerUseMark: Waxay u oggolaanaysaa Kartographer inuu ka soo saaro qaabka CSS ee uu xiriirku ka isticmaali doono GeoJSON.
managewiki-setting-wgEnableUploads-help: Hubi ama ka saar hubinta ikhtiyaarkan haddii aad rabto inaad awoodsiiso ama joojiso soo dejinta faylasha ee wiki-gaaga.
managewiki-setting-wgAllowCopyUploads-na: Awoodsiinta Soo Dejinta Faylasha Iyadoo loo Marayo URL
managewiki-setting-wgAllowCopyUploads-he: Sida caadiga ah, Miraheze waxay awoodsiisaa soo dejinta faylasha oo keliya warbaahinta maxalliga ah, laakiin ikhtiyaarkan waxaad faylasha meel fog uga soo dejisan kartaa bogag kale.
managewiki-setting-wgCopyUploadsFromSpec: Awoodsiinta Soo Dejinta Faylasha Iyadoo loo Marayo URL ee Special:Upload
Ikhtiyaarkani wuxuu ku darayaa sanduuqa qoraalka Special:Upload, kaas oo kuu oggolaanaya inaad faylasha ka soo dejiso URL kasta.
managewiki-setting-wgUseInstantCommons-h: Tani waxay kuu oggolaanaysaa inaad wiki-gaaga ku isticmaasho faylasha kaydka Wikimedia Commons.
managewiki-setting-wgMirahezeCommons-hel: Tani waxay kuu oggolaanaysaa inaad wiki-gaaga ku isticmaasho faylasha kaydka Miraheze Commons.
managewiki-setting-wgShowArchiveThumbnai: Ku muuji Sawirrada Yaryar ee Hore Bogga Sharaxaadda
In bogga sharaxaadda sawirka lagu muujiyo sawirrada yaryar ee sawirradii hore.
managewiki-setting-wgAllowExternalImages: Waxay go'aamisaa in MediaWiki uu oggolaanayo iyo in kale in sawirrada dibadda si toos ah loogu muujiyo qoraalka dhexdiisa.
managewiki-setting-wgAllowImageTag-help: Oggolow in summadda img lagu isticmaalo Wikitext.
managewiki-setting-wgSVGConverter-help: Tani waxay dooranaysaa beddelaha loo isticmaalo in Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) loogu beddelo PNG. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad doorato Inkscape haddii natiijada beddelka SVG->PNG ay noqoto sawir madow.
managewiki-setting-wgMediaViewerEnableBy: Tani waxay MediaViewer u awoodsiinaysaa qof kasta.
managewiki-setting-wgMSU_checkAutoCat-na: Hubinta qaybaha tooska ah ee MsUpload
managewiki-setting-wgMSU_checkAutoCat-he: Haddii la dejiyo, waxay si caadi ah u calaamadaynaysaa sanduuqa hubinta ee qayb lagu darayo bogga.
managewiki-setting-wgMSU_confirmReplace-: Haddii la dejiyo, waxay muujinaysaa sanduuqa hubinta "Beddel faylka".
managewiki-setting-wgMSU_showAutoCat-nam: Muujinta qaybta otomaatig ah ee MsUpload
managewiki-setting-wgMSU_showAutoCat-hel: Haddii la dejiyo, faylasha la soo geliyo iyadoo la tafatirayo bog qayb ah waxaa lagu dari doonaa qaybtaas.
managewiki-setting-wgMSU_useDragDrop-nam: MsUpload ha isticmaalo jiidid iyo dhigista
managewiki-setting-wgMSU_useDragDrop-hel: Haddii la dejiyo, aagga jiididda iyo dhigista ayaa la muujin doonaa.
managewiki-setting-wgCommonsMetadataForc: Ku qas falanqaynta sharraxaadda sawirrada fog
U deji run si aad ugu qasabto CommonsMetadata inay falanqayso bogga sharraxaadda sawirka oo ay ka soo saarto xogta macluumaadka marka la isticmaalayo sawirro laga keenay wiki-yo kale.
managewiki-setting-wgCookieWarningMoreUr: URL dheeraad ah oo digniinta kukiga ah
managewiki-setting-wgEchoCrossWikiNotifi: Ogeysiisyada Echo ee ka gudba wiki-yada
In la hawlgeliyo astaanta ogeysiisyada ka gudba wiki-yada iyo in kale.
managewiki-setting-wgEchoMentionStatusNo: Hawl geli ogeysiisyada guusha ama guuldarrada xusitaanka.
managewiki-setting-wmgSiteNoticeOptOut-n: Ka bax ogeysiisyada guud ee Miraheze
managewiki-setting-wmgSiteNoticeOptOut-h: Waxay wiki-gaaga ka saartaa ogeysiisyada guud ee Miraheze, iyadoo keliya muujinaysa ogeysiisyada muhiimka ah.
managewiki-setting-wgModerationNotificat: Haddii la dejiyo, iimayl ogeysiin ah ayaa loo diri doonaa "Iimaylka Dhexdhexaadinta" mar kasta oo wax-ka-beddel loo diro safka dhexdhexaadinta.
Ogeysiiska dhexdhexaadinta ee cusub oo keliya
Haddii la dejiyo, ogeysii oo keliya bogagga cusub, laakiin ha ogeysiin wax ka beddellada lagu sameeyo bogagga jira.
managewiki-setting-wgDismissableSiteNoti: Ogeysiiska goobta ee la xiri karo ee loogu talagalay isticmaalayaasha aan la aqoonsan
Tani waxay kuu oggolaanaysaa inaad dejiso in booqdayaasha aan la aqoonsan ee wiki-ga ay awood u yeeshaan inay xiraan ogeysiiska goobta ee la tusay iyo in kale.
managewiki-setting-wgServer-help: Sida caadiga ah, wiki-gaaga waxaa laga heli karaa https://yourwiki.miraheze.org — oo ah hoosaad ka tirsan Miraheze. Waxaad naga codsan kartaa inaan wiki-gaaga u leexinno domain aad leedahay. Hadda, weli suurtagal ma aha in tan la sameeyo iyada oo aan laga helin caawimaad kooxda Tignoolajiyada, laakiin wax badan ayaad ka baran kartaa https://meta.miraheze.org/wiki/Custom_domains.
managewiki-setting-wgMobileUrlTemplate-h: Tani waxay dejinaysaa URL-ka moobilkaaga. Sida caadiga ah waa [domain].
managewiki-setting-wgDefaultRobotPolicy-: Waxay oggolaanaysaa in la qeexo siyaasadda caadiga ah ee Robot-yada dhammaan bogagga wiki-ga.
managewiki-setting-wgModerationEmail-hel: Waxay dejinaysaa iimaylka loo dirayo ogeysiisyada.
managewiki-setting-wgAccountCreationThro: Tirada akoonnada uu cinwaan kasta oo IP ahi abuuri karo, 0 si loo joojiyo.
managewiki-setting-wgSVGMetadataCutoff-h: Ha akhrin xogta macluumaadka SVG-ga wixii ka dambeeya meeshan.
managewiki-setting-wgMaxArticleSize-help: Cabbirka ugu badan ee bogga ee kilobayt ahaan.
managewiki-setting-wgMaxImageArea-help: Waxay qeexaysaa tirada ugu badan ee pixels-ka uu sawir yeelan karo.
managewiki-setting-wgFileExtensions-help: Tani waa liiska fidinnada la doorbiday ee lagu soo gelinayo faylasha. Soo gelinta faylal leh fidinno aan liiskan lagu dooran waxay kicin doontaa digniin.
managewiki-setting-wgDefaultSkin-help: Tani waxay beddeshaa is-dhexgalka muuqaalka oo ay u beddeshaa muuqaalka la doortay dhammaan isticmaalayaasha, hase yeeshee waxaa lagu beddeli karaa dookhyada isticmaalaha.
managewiki-setting-wgLogo-help: Tani waxay beddeli doontaa astaanta caadiga ah ee Miraheze. Ka eeg https://meta.miraheze.org/wiki/ManageWiki#How_do_I_change_my_logo.2Ffavicon.3F sida aad u beddeli karto.
managewiki-setting-wgFavicon-help: Favicon-ku waa sawir gaaban oo lagu muujiyo barta cinwaanka biraawsarka booqdaha iyo bogga kaydinta bogagga la calaamadeeyey. Inta badan waa nooc ka yar astaanta. Ka eeg https://meta.miraheze.org/wiki/ManageWiki#How_do_I_change_my_logo.2Ffavicon.3F sida aad mid ugu dari karto.
managewiki-setting-wgAppleTouchIcon-help: Favicon-ka qalabka moobilka Apple. Ka eeg https://meta.miraheze.org/wiki/ManageWiki#How_do_I_change_my_logo.2Ffavicon.3F sida aad mid ugu dari karto.
managewiki-setting-wgMetrolookDownArrow-: Doorsoomahan qaabayntu waa inuu noqdaa run si taayillada loo abuuro.
managewiki-setting-wgMetrolookUploadButt: Marka la hawlgeliyo, xiriirinta "Soo geli fayl" ayaa lagu abuuraa baarka menu-ga sare, ka hor xiriirinnada ficillada u gaarka ah nuxurka sida "Taariikhda", "Wadahadalka", iyo wixii la mid ah.
managewiki-setting-wgMetrolookBartile-he: Marka la hawlgeliyo "Fallaarta hoos ee Metrolook" iyo "Bartile-ka Metrolook", menu-ga taayillada waxaa laga abuuri doonaa [[MediaWiki:Metrolook-tiles]]. Haddii "Fallaarta hoos ee Metrolook" aan la dejin oo "Bartile-ka Metrolook" aan la dejin, markaas menu-ga taayillada waxaa laga abuuri doonaa [[MediaWiki:Metrolook-tiles-second]].
managewiki-setting-wgMetrolookMobile-hel: Marka la hawlgeliyo, waxay ka dhigaysaa is-dhexgalka mid la jaanqaadaya moobayllada.
managewiki-setting-wgMetrolookUseIconWat: Marka la hawlgeliyo, waxay isticmaashaa astaan loogu talagalay badhanka la socodka/joojinta la socodka.
managewiki-setting-wgMetrolookLine-help: Haddii aan la dejin, qaybta img.line (xariiqda kala qaybisa ee caddaanka ah ee ku jirta menu-ga sare, ee u dhexaysa magaca goobta iyo fallaarta hoos/"Soo geli fayl" xiriirinta) lama abuuri doono.
managewiki-setting-wgRelatedArticlesFoot: Muuqaallada loo oggol yahay gunta maqaallada la xiriira
Liiska magacyada muuqaalada (tusaale ahaan, "minerva", "vector") ee maqaallada la xiriira lagu muujin doono gunta bogga.
managewiki-setting-wgMultiBoilerplateDip: Muujinta bogga gaarka ah ee MultiBoilerplate
Haddii la dejiyo, wiki-ga waxaa lagu dari doonaa bog la yiraahdo Special:Boilerplates oo muujinaya qaab-dhismeedyada hore loo habeeyey ee hadda jira.
managewiki-setting-wgAllowUserCss-help: U oggolow xaashiyaha qaabka is-dul-saaran (CSS) ee isticmaalaha. Tusaale ahaan User:Username/*.css.
managewiki-setting-wgAllowUserJs-help: U oggolow bogagga JavaScript (JS) ee isticmaalaha. Tusaale ahaan User:Username/*.js.
managewiki-setting-wgDefaultTheme-help: Waxay dejinaysaa mawduuca si caadi ah loo muujinayo marka isticmaalayaashu booqdaan wiki-gaaga.
managewiki-setting-wgManageWikiForceSide: Qasab ka dhig xiriirinnada dhinaca ee Maamul Wiki-ga
Qasab ka dhig in xiriirinnada Maamul Wiki-ga lagu muujiyo dhinaca dhammaan isticmaalayaasha. Qoraalka xiriirintu wuu ka duwanaan doonaa isticmaalayaasha aan lahayn mudnaanta.
